# Run A: `112 101` (pi, set routing)

**Argument resolution.** There are two PR tokens and no `--rebase` flag, so this run takes the set-routing row (`reference/batch.md`).

1. `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. That normalizes to `acme/widgets`, and both bare numbers resolve against this origin.
2. Admission checks run before any effect, and all pass:
   - There is no positional issue reference.
   - There are no duplicate identities.
   - No token is a URL from another repository.
   - The harness is pi.
   - The set holds 2 PRs, within the cap of 4 from pi-cohort `parallel.maxTasks`. The set is never chunked.
3. Because this is a typed set, there is no `discovered, smallest first:` line. Token order stays 112, then 101.
4. The parent `RUN_DIR` is minted from the session checkout through `### Continuation record`, and it succeeds. The roster, per-PR folders and records are not created yet.

**Gather.** Each admitted token is passed unchanged as `pr_token`:

5. `gh pr view 112 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '<linearRefs + 300-char body projection>'` returns the #112 row above.
6. The same command for `101` returns the #101 row above.
7. `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`, read once.
8. `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns `acme/reviewers`, read once.

**Ticket display.**

9. `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` resolves the default branch.
10. `git show <ref>:<path>` runs for each overrides path in search order. None sets a tracker, so Linear IDs remain allowed. No Linear lookup is needed because neither PR yields a Linear ID.

**How each entry is built.**
- **#112:** The author is `pat`, not the viewer, and no review is requested, so the entry reads `by pat`. The ticket is the first closing reference, #22, which belongs to `acme/widgets` and so takes the short label.
- **#101:** The author matches `alex`, so the entry reads `yours`. There is no closing reference. The branch `gh-45-retry` starts with `gh-45`, so the ticket is #45, linked to origin's issues.

Message the human sees (its own message, no marker, no wait):

PRs to gate:
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - centralize settings reads through one shared resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout for slow requests

**Next step:** Serial provisioning in the parent (`reference/batch.md` `## Provision serially`). It starts with one `git fetch origin`. No `pull/<N>/head` fetch is needed because neither PR is cross-repository. The gitignore-first rule applies if the worktree home is inside the primary checkout. PRs are then provisioned one at a time in roster order, 112 first. There is no rebase, so no set-wide confirmation is asked.

# Run B: `97` (single-PR path)

**Argument resolution.** There is one PR token, no issue reference and no `--rebase` flag, so this run stays on the single-PR path.

1. Mint the run folder and initialize its continuation record.
2. Run `plan_tracker` `init` with the stages `gather`, `provision`, `verify`. There is no `sync` stage because no rebase was requested.

**Step 1, Gather** (`verification-brief.md` Section A fixed commands, all succeeding):

3. `gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests`
4. `gh run list -R acme/widgets -c <headRefOid> --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`
5. `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
6. `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns `acme/reviewers`.
7. `gh api graphql` (the viewerPermission, viewerCanUpdateBranch, viewerCanMergeAsAdmin and viewerCanClose query) with `o=acme r=widgets n=97`.
8. `gh repo view acme/widgets --json nameWithOwner`
9. `gh pr diff 97`
10. `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/reviews --paginate`
11. `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/comments --paginate`
12. `gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/97/comments --paginate`
13. `git worktree list --porcelain` shows no worktree for #97.

**Results from the gather.**
- `viewer.role` is `requested reviewer`, because the pending User request is for `alex`.
- `issue_ref` is null. No closing reference exists, and the branch, title, body and commits name no ticket.

**Ticket display.**

14. `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` resolves the default branch.
15. `git show <ref>:<path>` runs for each overrides path. There is no tracker override.
16. The ticket resolves to `no ticket`:
    - There is no closing reference.
    - The branch `csv-export` has no `gh-<N>` and no Linear-shaped ID.
    - The title has no ticket token.
    - The title and body contain no Linear address.

Message the human sees (its own message, no marker, no wait):

PR to gate:
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - add a CSV export button for the widget list

**Next step:** Step 2, Provision + configure (`reference/assessment.md`). This step:
- provisions the #97 worktree and verifies that its HEAD equals the head SHA;
- resolves configuration from the merge-base;
- finds no ticket to fetch, so it selects the scope contract from a spec at the head, or else from the PR's stated intent.

## Run A: `112 101`

1. Resolve origin with `git remote get-url origin`. Read pi-cohort's active configuration: the repository is `acme/widgets`, the set limit is four, and the two distinct PRs pass admission in argument order.

2. Create the parent run folder with `mktemp -d`, then initialize its continuation record before initializing progress tracking. The parent tracks `pr-112` and `pr-101`, in that order; it does not initialize single-PR assessment stages.

3. Run this gather command twice, first with `pr_token=112`, then with `pr_token=101`:

   `gh pr view "$pr_token" --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'`

4. Read the viewer and team memberships once each:

   - `gh api user --jq .login`
   - `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'`

5. Resolve the trusted default-branch reference with `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`. Check the project overrides there, in the prescribed search order, using `git show` for `.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `gauntlet-overrides.md`, and `doc/gauntlet-overrides.md`, stopping at the first existing file. There is no tracker override.

The pre-provisioning message is:

PRs to gate:
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - centralize settings reads through one resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout

Next step: **Provision serially**, preserving the order #112, then #101. No fetch, provisioning command, verification, or helper dispatch has run.

## Run B: `97`

1. Create a separate run folder with `mktemp -d`, then initialize its continuation record. Initialize the tracker stages `gather`, `provision`, and `verify`, and start `gather`.

2. Run the initial PR read:

   `gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests`

   Use its URL to bind all subsequent GitHub reads to `acme/widgets` and PR #97.

3. Complete the fixed gather reads in order. In these commands, `$HEAD` is the exact head returned by the initial PR read; this exercise does not supply its literal SHA.

   - `gh run list -R acme/widgets -c "$HEAD" --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`
   - `gh api user --jq .login`
   - `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'`
   - `gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!){ repository(owner:$o,name:$r){ viewerPermission pullRequest(number:$n){ viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin viewerCanClose headRefOid body baseRefName } } }' -f o=acme -f r=widgets -F n=97`
   - `gh repo view acme/widgets --json nameWithOwner`
   - `gh pr diff 97 -R acme/widgets`
   - `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/reviews --paginate`
   - `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/comments --paginate`
   - `gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/97/comments --paginate`
   - `git worktree list --porcelain`

   There are no reviewer placeholders requiring additional workflow reads. The issue-reference search finds no ticket.

4. Resolve origin with `git remote get-url origin`. Resolve its default-branch reference with `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`, then perform the same trusted overrides lookup for ticket display. There is no tracker override and no ticket to look up.

5. Complete `gather`. Leave `provision` and `verify` pending.

The pre-provisioning message is:

PR to gate:
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - add a CSV export button for the widget list

Next step: **Step 2, Provision + configure**. No provisioning command or helper has run, and no SHA has yet been verified or assessed by the verification brief.
